sections.title: Taxable Realized Gain/Loss Summary, Year To Date
Gain/Loss Review by Account, Last 12 Months

document.shape: One filled report per household. A filled report is one JSON object with exactly two keys, household and values (document.filled_report states the layout). household is {household_ref, as_of, first_data_date, accounts}: household_ref is the household's reference, as_of the report date, first_data_date the earliest first_data_date of its accounts, and accounts one entry per account of the household in account_id order, each entry {account_id, last4, first_data_date, window_status}. values is an object keyed by member id with exactly one entry per member in members. A member whose grain is an account or an asset class holds {"by_row": {"<account_id or asset class>": figure}} (filled_report.per_row_member_form); a chart member holds a list of series {name, points: [{date, value}]}, a point with no measured figure left out, and a chart with no measured point holds its absent form. A value is a number, a text, or {"absent": "<reason in words>"}. A member whose source is ABSENT always holds the absent form, never zero and never a default. Units follow each member's unit: dollars as whole dollars with thousands separators; percent to one decimal place; text as written; series as the list the chart reads. A percent member holds PERCENT POINTS: a stored 1.5 means 1.5 percent, and a consumer must not scale it again (the unit_scale field on each percent member names this). The sample builder writes this object from the sibling contracts named in each member's source; the tab and the export read it by member id and print every absent form as its words. Neither the tab nor the export derives a figure from another source.

filled_report.per_row_member_form: a member whose grain is an account (the account value summaries, the activity account rows, the realized-lot members and the account gain-loss review) or an asset class (hold.allocation) holds {"by_row": {"<account_id or asset class>": figure}}, with one key per account of the household or per asset class; a figure is a number, a text, or the absent form {absent, kind}, and an asset-class entry the household holds none of is the text UNHELD (document.unheld_rule); a household-grain member holds its figure or its absent form directly, never a by_row map
filled_report.window_status_rule: for each of the four windows (qtd, ytd, last_12_months, since_inception), with the window's opening anchor day (for since_inception, the account's first_data_date): NOT_SPANNED when the account has no account_return_daily row on the opening anchor day; BREAK when the opening anchor day is SOURCE_LAG, or when a day inside the window (after the anchor, up to and including as_of) has no row, a SOURCE_LAG row, a null total_return_daily or a GRADED_DISAGREED guard_state; else MEASURED, read from the account return table
filled_report.first_data_date_rule: an account's first_data_date is the business_date of its first row in the account return table, across every date= partition; the household's first_data_date is the earliest of its accounts' first_data_date values

account.order: the household's accounts in account_id order; one row per account, labelled with its registration name and last four digits (the registration name is absent, so the label carries the absent form until a name source exists)

class_hierarchy.class_level: Opal's asset-class enumeration from account_class_daily asset_class (seven values: cash, fixed_income, equity, structured, alternatives, commodities, unclassified), in the baseline's printed class order where a baseline class has an Opal counterpart
class_hierarchy.sub_class_level: ABSENT. The baseline's sub-class rows (for example the large-cap, mid-cap, international, municipal and high-yield rows) are not carried by any sibling; each sub-class cell holds the absent form with the reason in words. A class with no holding prints a dash, which is an absent form, never zero.
class_hierarchy.grain: household by class (holdings overview) and account by class (gain/loss review)

quarter_to_date.start_rule: the first calendar day of the calendar quarter containing as_of (1 January, 1 April, 1 July or 1 October)
quarter_to_date.opening_anchor: the last trading day before the start day, from lib/trading_calendar.py

year_to_date.opening_anchor: the last trading day before 1 January, from lib/trading_calendar.py

last_12_months.start_rule: the calendar day one year before as_of
last_12_months.opening_anchor: the last trading day before that calendar day, from lib/trading_calendar.py

month_to_date.start_rule: the first calendar day of as_of's month
month_to_date.opening_anchor: the last trading day before that day, from lib/trading_calendar.py
month_to_date.reason: not a ruled period: no sibling carries it; the month-to-date members are absent

since_inception.start_rule: the account's first_data_date (the household's inception is the earliest first_data_date among its accounts)
since_inception.opening_anchor: none: the window opens on first_data_date
since_inception.annualization: the baseline annualizes since inception past one year; the served since-inception return is cumulative and is printed as cumulative; annualization is not in any sibling

document.household_sum_rule: a household figure built by summing accounts is absent when any contributing account term is absent; a partial sum is never printed as the household figure

footnotes.not_held_for_entire_period: a window whose figure is absent because the account did not span it (window_status NOT_SPANNED) prints a dash with the footnote 'Not held for the entire period' in place of the figure (member convention.not_held_for_entire_period)
footnotes.inception_per_household_and_account: the since-inception column is headed with the inception date of that household or that account (member convention.inception_per_household_and_account)
footnotes.fee_basis: the fee-basis words in convention.fee_basis_label print beside every Opal return and gain column and beside every baseline Net Gain column, so the two are never silently matched

document.absent_rule: ABSENT is never zero. A figure with no value holds the form {"absent": reason, "kind": KIND} in values: the reason is printed in words, and KIND is one of document.absent_kinds. NO_SOURCE_YET: Opal has no source for the figure yet. INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: the source holds too little history for the period, and the remedy is time. SOURCE_BREAK: a source repair is the remedy, as for a missing row, a lagging row, a null return or a disagreeing guard. A member with source ABSENT carries NO_SOURCE_YET. A window with no measured figure prints its absent form; a window the account did not span (NOT_SPANNED) carries INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY and prints the not-held dash. The kind is read from the kind field, never inferred from the reason text.
document.unheld_rule: An asset-class entry in a by_row map (hold.allocation) that holds the text UNHELD means the household holds none of that asset class on as_of. It prints the baseline's dash, never a reason and never zero. UNHELD is not an absent form, so it carries no kind, and it may appear only as the value of an asset-class key of a by_row map.

members.baseline: section 1 Portfolio Overview Portfolio Value Summary, table Portfolio Value Summary, column Quarter To Date, row Beginning Value
members.label: Beginning value, quarter to date

source.fold: sum over the household's accounts of market_value_eod of this account on the window's opening anchor day (the last trading day before the first day of the calendar quarter containing as_of), the whole-account value at end of day with cash included; an account with no row on its anchor day did not hold a value at the window's start: its term is absent, never zero, and its window is NOT_SPANNED, so it prints the not-held dash; absent, never zero, when that row's day_quality is SOURCE_LAG; a household sum is absent when any account term is absent (document.household_sum_rule), never a partial sum

members.baseline: section 1 Portfolio Overview Portfolio Value Summary, table Portfolio Value Summary, column Quarter To Date, row Net Additions
members.label: Net additions, quarter to date

source.fold: sum over the household's accounts of the sum of external_flow (net external flow, capital-in positive) over this account's rows for the quarter to date window: the trading days after its opening anchor (the last trading day before the first day of the calendar quarter containing as_of) up to and including as_of; each row's carried_days already folds the flows of a skipped closure into its trading day, so every flow is counted once; absent when any trading day of the window has no row for this account or a row there is SOURCE_LAG (that day's flow is unknown), never zero; a household sum is absent when any account term is absent (document.household_sum_rule), never a partial sum

members.baseline: section 1 Portfolio Overview Portfolio Value Summary, table Portfolio Value Summary, column Quarter To Date, row Net Gain (the baseline footnote says it includes fees)
members.label: Net gain before advisory fees, quarter to date

source.fold: sum over the household's accounts of each account's ending_value minus beginning_value minus net_additions over the quarter to date window: the trading days after its opening anchor (the last trading day before the first day of the calendar quarter containing as_of) up to and including as_of; a gain BEFORE advisory fees (convention.fee_basis_label: the baseline's Net Gain includes fees, so the two are not the same figure); absent when any account term is absent (document.household_sum_rule), never a partial sum

source.fold: market_value_eod of this account on the window's opening anchor day (the last trading day before the first day of the calendar quarter containing as_of), the whole-account value at end of day with cash included; an account with no row on its anchor day did not hold a value at the window's start: its term is absent, never zero, and its window is NOT_SPANNED, so it prints the not-held dash; absent, never zero, when that row's day_quality is SOURCE_LAG

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Quarter To Date, row Net Additions
members.label: Net additions, quarter to date

source.fold: the sum of external_flow (net external flow, capital-in positive) over this account's rows for the quarter to date window: the trading days after its opening anchor (the last trading day before the first day of the calendar quarter containing as_of) up to and including as_of; each row's carried_days already folds the flows of a skipped closure into its trading day, so every flow is counted once; absent when any trading day of the window has no row for this account or a row there is SOURCE_LAG (that day's flow is unknown), never zero

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Quarter To Date, row Net Gain (the baseline footnote says it includes fees)

source.fold: ending_value minus beginning_value minus net_additions for this account, the three terms above read from the same rows: a gain BEFORE advisory fees (convention.fee_basis_label: the baseline's Net Gain includes fees, so the two are not the same figure); absent when any of the three terms is absent; it is a residual and is never plugged to tie

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Quarter To Date, row Ending Value
members.label: Ending value (as of the report date)

source.fold: market_value_eod of this account on as_of, the whole-account value at end of day with cash included; absent, never zero, when there is no row on as_of or as_of's day_quality is SOURCE_LAG

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Quarter To Date, row Return (Cumulative)
members.label: Return, cumulative, before advisory fees, quarter to date

source.fold: the account's cumulative return over the quarter to date window: the trading days after its opening anchor (the last trading day before the first day of the calendar quarter containing as_of) up to and including as_of: the product of (1 + total_return_daily) over the window's trading days, minus 1, read from this account's rows. Guard and day rules: a row whose total_return_daily is null (day_quality NOT_MEASURABLE or SOURCE_LAG, where the geometric link breaks) makes the window ABSENT with the gap date named, never bridged; a row whose guard_state is GRADED_DISAGREED serves no number (ruling 17), so the window is ABSENT; a row whose day_quality is FLOW_UNRECONCILED or LARGE_FLOW, or whose guard_state is NOT_GRADED_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN, NOT_GRADED_NO_NEIGHBOUR or GUARD_NOT_REACHED, compounds as served and the window carries that flag. An account with no row on its anchor day is NOT_SPANNED: its term is absent, its window prints the not-held dash, and its figure is never a compounding over the part it held

source.fold: cumulative last 12 months return: the product of (1 + the daily index-benchmark return of the served model series) over the series' trading days d with start <= d <= the as-of date, minus 1, as a percent rounded to 1 dp; start is one calendar year before the as-of date, plus one day (the household-level start, the same for every account column); absent in words, never zero and never interpolated, when the series does not open on the start or holds no return on a trading day of the window

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Since <inception>, row Beginning Value
members.label: Beginning value, since inception

source.fold: market_value_eod of this account on the account's first valued day (its first emitted account_return_daily row, the first day its market_value_eod exists), the whole-account value at end of day with cash included; an account with no row on its anchor day did not hold a value at the window's start: its term is absent, never zero, and its window is NOT_SPANNED, so it prints the not-held dash; absent, never zero, when that row's day_quality is SOURCE_LAG

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Since <inception>, row Net Additions
members.label: Net additions, since inception

source.fold: the sum of external_flow (net external flow, capital-in positive) over this account's rows for the since-inception window: the trading days after the account's first valued day up to and including as_of; each row's carried_days already folds the flows of a skipped closure into its trading day, so every flow is counted once; absent when any trading day of the window has no row for this account or a row there is SOURCE_LAG (that day's flow is unknown), never zero

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Since <inception>, row Net Gain (the baseline footnote says it includes fees)
members.label: Net gain before advisory fees, since inception

source.fold: ending_value minus beginning_value minus net_additions for this account, the three terms above read from the same rows: a gain BEFORE advisory fees (convention.fee_basis_label: the baseline's Net Gain includes fees, so the two are not the same figure); absent when any of the three terms is absent; it is a residual and is never plugged to tie

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Since <inception>, row Ending Value
members.label: Ending value (as of the report date)

source.fold: market_value_eod of this account on as_of, the whole-account value at end of day with cash included; absent, never zero, when there is no row on as_of or as_of's day_quality is SOURCE_LAG

members.baseline: section 5 Account Overview Account Value Summary, table Account Value Summary, column Since <inception>, row Return (Cumulative)
members.label: Return, cumulative, before advisory fees, since inception

source.fold: the account's cumulative return over the since-inception window: the trading days after the account's first valued day up to and including as_of: the product of (1 + total_return_daily) over the window's trading days, minus 1, read from this account's rows. Guard and day rules: a row whose total_return_daily is null (day_quality NOT_MEASURABLE or SOURCE_LAG, where the geometric link breaks) makes the window ABSENT with the gap date named, never bridged; a row whose guard_state is GRADED_DISAGREED serves no number (ruling 17), so the window is ABSENT; a row whose day_quality is FLOW_UNRECONCILED or LARGE_FLOW, or whose guard_state is NOT_GRADED_OUTSIDE_DOMAIN, NOT_GRADED_NO_NEIGHBOUR or GUARD_NOT_REACHED, compounds as served and the window carries that flag. An account with no row on its anchor day is NOT_SPANNED: its term is absent, its window prints the not-held dash, and its figure is never a compounding over the part it held

members.baseline: section 0 Cover, household name line

members.reason: The client summary carries ids only, by design: no name and no custodian account number. No sibling holds the household's display name. It would come from the household's directory entry, which is outside these contracts.

members.baseline: section 0 Cover, Accounts list, each as registration name then masked number
members.label: Accounts, each with its registration name and last four digits
members.reason: The account list needs each account's registration name, and no sibling holds it. The account tables carry the custodian account id, so the last four digits can be shown once a registration-name source exists. The client summary holds only issued opaque account ids, which no sibling maps to the custodian id (see open_changes).

source.fold: one series per model, named with its served name; a point on each trading day d of the series with one calendar year before the as-of date, plus one day, <= d <= the as-of date, carrying the cumulative percent of the product of (1 + the daily index-benchmark return) from that start through d, minus 1, rounded to 1 dp; the last point of each series equals that model's last_12_months benchmark member; the household's own line is not in this member

members.label: Since-inception column is headed with that household's or that account's inception date

members.baseline: disclosure page (not in the baseline export): every page says the report is incomplete without it
members.label: Disclosure page
members.reason: The baseline export does not include the disclosure page, and no sibling holds its text. The method row carries the GIPS-alignment statement (the dim_return_method gips_alignment field) that the page will quote; the rest of the text needs its own source.

change_rule: a member whose source changes names the new field in the sibling's own versioned edit; a derivation the siblings do not carry (a household return series, a benchmark series, a month-to-date window, the registration name, the disclosure text) is a new field or a new contract before this contract sources it, and the contract changes by a version bump with the gap table re-bound to its bytes
read_rule: values are read by member id; an ABSENT member prints its reason in words; a figure is never derived from a source this contract does not name; the fee-basis words print beside every Opal return and gain figure and every baseline Net Gain figure
open_changes: the household return series and the household daily return: a new contract (household return rule); until then the household return members are ABSENT

the four model benchmark return series: sourced at version 0.4.0 from the served dated model series (input model_portfolio_timeseries); the 32 benchmark members and the 12-month chart are compounded from its daily returns, each window's start stated in its fold; a figure whose window the series does not open on, or whose trading days it does not hold, prints its absent reason in words
month to date: a ruling is needed before a sibling carries it; until then the month-to-date members are ABSENT
the registration names and the disclosure text: no sibling holds them; the cover, account rows and disclosure page print absent forms

the since-inception convention: the baseline's conventions note says since inception is annualized past one year, while its Portfolio Value Summary row reads Return (Cumulative); the served figure is cumulative and is printed as cumulative until a ruling says otherwise

the account id spaces: the client summary holds issued opaque account ids, while the account tables key on the custodian account id; no sibling maps one to the other, so the masked account number on the cover cannot come from the summary alone
